contexts.text: He put a chain of gold upon his neck () = a significative of the conjunction of the interiors with the exteriors, which is brought about by good. A chain, as it encircles the neck, is a significative of their conjunction; a chain of gold = conjunction by means of good. Illustrated.
A chain () = truth from good as to influx, and thence the conjunction of the interiors with the exteriors. AE 195:7. AE 242:15.
Some (idols) they decorated with necklaces, etc.
